title: Missing-value analysis
question: Count the missing values separately for Country, Segment, and Sales in dbt_dev_gold.mart_rec_sales_gold_28f6ea4c. Use the governed warehouse analytics path.

stages.label: Format answer
stages.detail: Turning the bounded result into a concise answer.

result.generated_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Country" IS NULL) AS country_missing_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Segment" IS NULL) AS segment_missing_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Sales" IS NULL) AS sales_missing_count
FROM dbt_dev_gold.mart_rec_sales_gold_28f6ea4c;
